name: Suki Da!
source:
A highschool setting daily life otome game with the concept of "gender role reversal shoujo manga."

Helping the boys carrying heavy things, grabbing them as they're about to fall from tripping, picking them up and carrying them bridal or piggyback style. All those shoujo cliches but with the roles reversed.
translation:
一款以高中日常生活为舞台、以“性别角色互换的少女漫画”为概念的乙女游戏。

帮男生搬重物，在他们绊倒时一把扶住，用公主抱抱起他们，或是背着他们。少女漫画里的那些经典桥段，一应俱全，只是角色反了过来。
